name: witness-prep-ethics
description: Evaluates witness preparation activities for ethical compliance under ABA Formal Opinion 508 and Model Rules 3.3, 3.4, 8.4. Distinguishes permissible preparation from prohibited coaching. Use when planning deposition or trial prep, reviewing proposed prep activities, or checking witness coaching ethics. Triggers: witness prep, deposition prep, coaching ethics, ABA 508, testimony preparation.
